title: Hacer robustos los CREATE append-only bajo main concurrente
mission: Implement and test a reusable control-plane helper/protocol path for append-only create-if-absent writes under heavy concurrent movement of main. It must distinguish an unrelated branch-head/CAS conflict from a true deterministic-path collision: refresh head and retry the same path only when the path is still absent; if the path exists, treat it as the authoritative lost race. Preserve pin/claim authority semantics and never overwrite existing evidence.
definition_of_done: A reusable executable helper or narrowly integrated implementation exists for append-only deterministic creates used by worker beacons/pins/receipts.
Tests cover unrelated main-head movement followed by successful retry of the same absent path.
Tests cover true path-exists collision and prove no variant path or duplicate execution claim is created.
No existing append-only evidence is updated or overwritten; compare-and-swap/preserve-first rules remain intact.
At least one current /wc write path is exercised with machine-auditable evidence.
